<img src="../../../../../images/grasshopper/components/goldendivide.png" alt="" width="48" height="48" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1rem;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px" />

Divides a curve into golden sections by arc length (a/b = φ).

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `GoldDiv`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to divide by the golden ratio (uses arc length). |
| FromEnd | `E` | Boolean | Item | `false` | If true, measure the longer part from the end; else from the start. |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Point | `P` | Point | Item | Golden division point on the curve. |
| t | `t` | Number | Item | Curve parameter at division (original domain). |
| A | `A` | Curve | Item | First subcurve. |
| B | `B` | Curve | Item | Second subcurve. |
